name: YHA Whitby
accommodation: Dorms, private and en-suite rooms, bell tents and a private chalet studio
suitableFor: Budget travellers, solo surfers and groups
parking: On-site car park (limited); Abbey Headland car park 0.4 miles
dogs: Pets allowed only in camping and cabin accommodation
beachAccess: Beside the abbey above the 199 steps; town a short walk
confirmedFeatures: Café, restaurant, licensed bar, self-catering kitchen, cycle store, luggage store, garden
overview: YHA Whitby sits beside the abbey ruins at the top of the 199 steps, overlooking the harbour. It offers dorms, private rooms, bell tents and a chalet studio, plus a café bar and self-catering kitchen. The town and harbour are a short walk down the steps.
surfTripFit: A budget base on the East Cliff with a kitchen and café, though beach trips mean a walk or short drive across town.
